# Science News

> Science News delivers breaking research and discoveries across all scientific disciplines, from human evolution and health to climate science and marine biology.

Science News is a comprehensive science journalism platform covering the latest advances in biology, earth science, health, and human sciences. The site organizes content through topic-specific hubs that allow readers to explore news in their areas of interest.

## Key Topics

- climate change
- human evolution
- genetics
- neuroscience
- microbes
- animals
- health and medicine
- environmental science
- earth science
- organ transplantation
- paleontology
- ecology and ecosystems
- agriculture
- marine science
- archaeology

## Core Access

- [Science News Homepage](https://www.sciencenews.org): Homepage featuring latest scientific advances across all disciplines
- [Subscription Plans](https://www.sciencenews.org/subscribe1): Subscription and membership tier options for Science News access

## Content Navigation

- [All Topics Directory](https://www.sciencenews.org/topics): Directory and archive index of all Science News topic pages

## Health & Human Sciences

- [Health & Medicine](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/health-medicine): Topic hub for health, medicine, and medical research articles
- [Humans](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/humans): Topic hub for anthropology, health, medicine, and psychology news
- [Psychology](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/psychology): Topic hub for psychology, neuroscience, and brain research articles
- [Neuroscience](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/neuroscience): Topic hub for brain research, genetics, and neuroscience news
- [Anthropology](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/anthropology): Topic hub for human evolution and archaeological discovery news
- [Archaeology](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/archaeology): Topic hub for archaeological findings and ancient human discoveries

## Life Sciences

- [Life](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/life): Topic hub for animals, plants, microbes, and life sciences news
- [Animals](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/animals): Topic hub for animal behavior, wildlife, and species research
- [Plants](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/plants): Topic hub for botany, agriculture, and plant science news
- [Microbes](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/microbes): Topic hub for microbiology and microbe research articles
- [Genetics](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/genetics): Topic hub for genetic research and evolutionary biology news
- [Paleontology](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/paleontology): Topic hub for dinosaurs, fossils, and prehistoric life research

## Earth & Environmental Sciences

- [Earth](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/earth): Topic hub for climate, geology, and environmental science news
- [Climate](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/climate): Topic hub for climate change and earth science articles
- [Oceans](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/oceans): Topic hub for ocean research, marine life, and sea science news
- [Ecosystems](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/ecosystems): Topic hub for ecology, conservation, and environmental science
- [Agriculture](https://www.sciencenews.org/topic/agriculture): Topic hub for agricultural research and farming science news
